name: Terminal
description: A command-line style panel that types its lines in once: a prompt, the commands, then the output. It has a copy button, and a still mode that shows every line at once. The lines are real text in the page from the start.

lines.description: The lines, each { text, kind }. kind is "command" (typed, with a prompt) or "output" (appears whole after a short pause). Default kind is command.

showCopy.description: Shows a Copy button that copies the commands (without prompts or output).

copiedLabel.description: Text of the button after copying.

isPaused.description: Still mode: shows every line at once and does not type.

keyboard: Tab: moves to the Copy button and to the scrollable text area
Enter or Space: copies the commands
requirements: The panel is a group named by label
Every line is real text in the server HTML and is readable with no JavaScript
While a line is being typed, the full text of the line is available to screen readers at once and the typed copy is hidden; nothing is read letter by letter
Typing runs once and stops; it never loops, so there is no moving content to stop after the lines are in
Reduced motion, isPaused and anything inside rdm-still show every line at once
The Copy button confirms with a polite status message
The text area scrolls and takes keyboard focus, so long lines are reachable without a mouse
screenReader: Group named by label, then the lines as plain text, then the Copy button

use_when: Showing an install or setup command
A short scripted demo of a command-line tool
anti_patterns: Typing very long scripts that delay the reader
